intro.title: Why Kužina.
paragraphs: Gušti iz Kužine means the pleasures of the kitchen. Kužina is the Istrian word for kitchen; gušti are the good things that come out of it.
I shop the Pula market that morning, at the fishmongers and the produce stalls. The meat comes from central Croatia. What I find decides the menu.
I spent years in fine-dining kitchens in Croatia and Ireland. I cook contemporary dishes with that training. The evening stays at your table.

items.q: How many guests do you cook for?
items.a: Up to six. For larger groups, ask me and I'll tell you what's possible.

items.q: How far in advance should I book?
items.a: At least four days before your dinner.
You book through my Take a Chef profile. Choose a date and send an enquiry there, and we arrange the details afterwards.
The price depends on the number of guests and the menu you choose. You get the exact quote on Take a Chef.
Payment goes through Take a Chef. Refunds and cancellations are handled there too.
I cook across Istria. For locations outside Istria, travel costs are agreed when we get in touch.

items.q: What do you need in the kitchen?
items.a: An ordinary home kitchen with a stove and an oven is enough. If something specific is needed, I'll let you know in advance.
Tell me about any allergies or dietary needs before we set the menu, and I'll plan around them.
Usually three to four hours, depending on the number of courses and the pace of the evening.

items.q: Do you leave the kitchen clean?
items.a: Yes. I wash up and clean the kitchen before I go.

privacyPage.metaDescription: How visitor data is handled on the Gušti iz Kužine website: what I collect, why, who receives it, and your rights.
privacyPage.title: Privacy policy
privacyPage.lead: This policy explains what personal data I collect through the Gušti iz Kužine website, why I use it, and what rights you have. It is written for visitors from the European Economic Area.

sections.title: Who is responsible
body: The controller is Tin Lučić, a private individual in Fažana, Croatia. I am not a registered company.
For any question about this policy or about how personal data is handled, write to the email address below.

sections.title: What data I collect
body: You send me data yourself when you fill in the contact form: first name, last name, email address, and the content of your message. Without that data I cannot reply to your enquiry, so providing it is necessary if you want an answer.
The server that hosts the site records technical data for each request, usually the IP address, the time, and the browser type. Those logs are used for security and to keep the site running.

The site sets no cookies unless you accept analytics. If you accept, Google Analytics 4 records the pages you visit, an approximate location derived from your IP address, your browser and device type, your language, and the site that referred you. It does not receive your name or email address.
If you accept analytics, I also record that the contact form was submitted. That event contains the form name and page language, not the name, email, or message you entered.
Your consent choice is stored in your browser's local storage.

sections.title: Why and on what legal basis
body: I use the form data only to reply to your enquiry and, if a booking follows, to arrange the details of the dinner. The legal basis is processing necessary to take steps before entering a contract and my legitimate interest in answering enquiries.
I use the server logs on the basis of my legitimate interest in the security and availability of the site.

I use the analytics data only on the basis of your consent, to understand which pages are read and to improve the site. I do not use it for advertising, remarketing, or marketing, I do not send a newsletter, and I do not combine it with other data to identify you. You can withdraw consent at any time; this does not affect processing that happened before the withdrawal.

sections.title: Who receives the data
body: The form sends the data to Web3Forms (Web3Creative), which acts as a processor. Web3Forms receives the message, stores it on Amazon Web Services, and forwards it to my email address.

Web3Forms screens submissions for spam and may send the sender's IP address and email address to external spam protection services in doing so. Email delivery runs through Amazon SES, and the message ends up in my Gmail inbox (Google).

If you accept analytics, Google Ireland Limited and Google LLC process the analytics data as my processors. Google may process data in the United States. You can read Google's privacy policy using the link below.
Vercel, the host, records technical data about requests. The development photographs are served by Unsplash, whose server also sees the visitor's IP address.
I do not sell the data or share it with third parties for marketing.

sections.title: Transfers outside the EEA
body: Web3Forms operates from India and uses the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses as the safeguard for transfers outside the European Economic Area. Amazon and Google process data in the United States; where required, the transfer relies on Standard Contractual Clauses or the EU-US Data Privacy Framework.
Google LLC processes analytics data in the United States; where required, the transfer relies on the EU-US Data Privacy Framework or the Standard Contractual Clauses.

sections.title: How long I keep data
body: Web3Forms stores submitted forms for up to three years. My email inbox keeps the message until the enquiry or booking is resolved, and then for up to 24 months for records and protection against legal claims.
Google Analytics keeps event data for 14 months. The analytics cookies last 90 days.
Vercel keeps technical server logs for a short period under its own retention policy.

sections.title: Your rights
body: You have the right to request access to your data, correction of inaccurate data, erasure, restriction of processing, objection to processing, and data portability. If processing is based on consent, you can withdraw it at any time.
If you have given consent, you can withdraw it at any time through the Cookie settings link in the footer.
To exercise your rights, write to the email address below. I will reply within one month.
If you believe the processing is unlawful, you can complain to the Croatian Personal Data Protection Agency (AZOP), Ulica Metela Ožegovića 16, 10000 Zagreb, phone +385 1 4609 000.

sections.title: Cookies and local storage
body: The site does not set cookies unless you accept analytics. The consent choice is stored in local storage, not a cookie, and is not used for tracking. Fonts are served from the site itself, so there are no requests to Google Fonts.

If you accept, Google Analytics sets _ga and _ga_<property> cookies to distinguish visitors and sessions. Both expire after 90 days. No analytics cookies are set before you accept, and rejecting keeps the site cookie-free.
You can change or withdraw your choice at any time through the Cookie settings link in the footer. You can also block or delete cookies in your browser.
When you submit the form, the data goes directly to Web3Forms. The development photographs load from Unsplash.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
body: If data processing changes, I will update this page and the last updated date. I will highlight material changes in a visible place.

sections.title: Contact
body: For questions about privacy and data processing, write to the email address below.
